title: Character twists and their action on equivariant coherent G-zero
statement: Let $F$ be a field and let $T$ be a group scheme over $F$. Let $Y$ be an $F$-scheme with algebraic $T$-action, and use its action-groupoid presentation, coherent linearized modules and integral group $G_0^T(Y)$ from [def-sfb-equivariant-coherent-gzero]. Use the characters $X=\operatorname{Hom}(T,\mathbf G_m)$, their universal evaluation and the integral ring $R=\mathbf Z[X]$ of [def-sfb-trivial-torus-coherent-data]. The one-dimensional rational character representation has coaction $v\mapsto v\otimes\chi$, in the conventions of [def-sfb-rational-representation-gzero]. A character twist $P$ of a coherent linearized module $M$ by $\chi$ consists of an underlying module isomorphism $e:P\simeq M$ such that, on $T\times_FY$, $(a^*e)\rho_P=\chi(\operatorname{pr}_1)\rho_M(p^*e)$, where $p=\operatorname{pr}_2$ and $\rho$ is the forward linearization $p^*M\simeq a^*M$. Thus the forward fibre action is multiplied by $\chi(t)$. An $R$-module structure on the existing additive group $G_0^T(Y)$ is the character action if every $\chi,M$ admits such a twist and, for every twist $P$, $e^\chi[M]=[P]$. These are predicates specifying the twist up to equivariant isomorphism and normalizing the action on every generator; the underlying coherent group is not redefined.
